name: pytrilogy
description: Can we improve the best language for data analytics? Strongly typed, composable, cross-engine SQL. More declarative and expressive, safer, and simpler for humans and agents.

paragraphs: Trilogy is a batteries-included data-productivity toolkit that accelerates SQL-based analytics with a typed, expressive language. It's great for humans - and even better for agents. Start with a single file and scale fast with a rich ecosystem, including UI and CLI tooling, public models to get started, rich python integration, and modern visuals and reporting.
SQL is the best way to work with data with but shows strain at scale and as it ages. Can we have the pros without the cons? We believe you can.

Trilogy adds a lightweight semantic layer to keep SQL fast through the full lifecycle of analytics - from exploration to production. It provides a full stack for interactive, visualization, and orchestration that can be adopted incrementally and without lock-in; start with checking types and asking agents questions; end with a more efficient and productive warehouse.
features: No manual joins; no from clause
Supports all standard engines: BigQuery, DuckDB, Snowflake, Presto
Easy to write - for humans and AI
